values.note: Pinellas County's own reservation system (rec1), by phone (727-582-2100, option 2) or at the county parks office. Six months ahead; Pinellas County residents seven months. At most 14 nights in any 30-day period; one reservation per person per day; full payment up front. Each change or cancellation costs a $10 administrative fee, or one night's site cost within two days of arrival.

summary: Fees stand (the county's year-round table, $45.50 / $47.50 for sites 86-236, unchanged). Added water + 30/50-amp electric at every site, 236 sites (86-236 take any rig), showers/dump/laundry/camp store/Wi-Fi at the office, and county booking: six months ahead (seven for residents), 14 nights in 30 days. Not stated: sewer, flush toilets ('modern restrooms' only), campground season (only 'Year-Round Rates'), pull-throughs and site lengths for 86-236.
